description: Require qualifying order, refund, user identity and repeat-window semantics before classifying repurchase.

guide.applicability: Use for a bounded cohort with reviewed purchase history and repeat-window definitions.
guide.context_boundary: Incomplete history cannot establish first or repeat purchase status, and returned differences do not prove motivation.
steps: Resolve qualifying order, refund, currency, user identity, cohort and repeat-window semantics.
Query governed returned purchase events and group only by approved cohort dimensions.
Report observed repeat behavior and history gaps without complete-lifetime or causal claims.
guide.title: Repeat-purchase cohort observation

summary: Describe returned repeat-purchase behavior under one project-owned window contract.
